notes: ἴσθι ἔχων: the periphrasis is split, 'have' going to the lexical participle and the imperative subject 'thou' to the copula under rule 9. Merging the pair into one unit on 'have thou' headed on 'have', on rule 73's reasoning about a collapsed pair, remains defensible.
δοῦλε is anarthrous, so the supplied address word 'thou' is an ordinary rule 7 helper on the noun (rule 89).
